alt: Screenshot of the ChatGPT Atlas browser interface, showing an AI-powered browser window with a ChatGPT sidebar alongside a standard web page
story: OpenAI launched the Atlas browser in October 2025 promising to 'rethink the web itself' with AI at the core — and is shutting it down August 9, 2026, less than 9 months later, after executives decided it was a 'side quest' and folded its features into a Chrome extension instead.
why_funny: They announced they were going to reinvent how all of humanity browses the internet, then quietly concluded the browser was basically a distraction and shipped a Chrome extension.
